svg.text: Plumbing works: kitchen, dish wash and grease trap
Plan view for the plumber walk-through. Schematic: pipe sizes, routes and the 90 L trap size are estimates for the plumber to confirm. Outfall not known yet. Metres.
to the OUTFALL: NOT KNOWN YET
Y8 washroom soil line: its own run, NOT through the trap
Store room (south of the kitchen): no water, no drain
Kitchen and dish-wash waste (to the trap)
Section through the grease trap Y6 (side view, schematic)
water; baffles hold the grease back
About 0.60 × 0.40 m, about 90 L (estimate, plumber sizes it). Emptied weekly. Inspection chamber Y7 follows, then the outfall.
Sewer, septic tank or soak pit, and its level vs the kitchen floor. Nothing
else is fixed until this is known.
Dish-wash floor drain and 100 mm line
D11 east through the cell opening and the east wall to the trap, 1:100 fall.
Wash sink D2 and rinse sink D3 join the 100 mm line.
Grease trap Y6 and chamber Y7
Cast masonry trap (about 90 L), sealed lid, chamber, line to the outfall.
Water poured at D11 must reach the outfall.
Hot-line trough Y1 and 75 mm outlet Y3
L-shaped trough 4.3 m with removable grating; outlet runs through the north
Existing sink, NE corner; waste joins Y3 so it passes the trap.
Kitchen falls to the trough, dish wash to D11, about 4 cm. Flood test before
Cold water from the 500 L tank D9
Cold main along the north wall. Check the tank bracket and wall under 500 L.
50 L heater D5 and hot to the sinks
Over table D1; hot runs east to D2 and D3.
Cold to the kitchen sink, wok tap and washroom basin
K28, wok tap K1 and the washroom basin. The kitchen has no separate hand
basin: K28 serves. Pressure test 1.5 × for 1 hour.
WC and floor trap on their own line, not through the trap. Where it meets the
• Where does the drain go, and is it lower than the trap outlet?
• Is 90 L right, and does the licence ask for a size or position?
• Where does the lid sit so it can be emptied weekly out of sight?
• Are 100, 75 and 50 mm lines enough? Where do the vents go?
• Where does the washroom line meet the main drain?
• Can the tank bracket take 500 L? Is the pressure enough?
• Flood and pressure tests: when, before any tile? Cost and time per item?
Sources: equipment plan (D, K, Y items), services sheet A-06, trade checklist 0.2, 2.1-2.4, 2.6, 4.4. Companion to the 3D page plumbing-3d.html. Schematic, not to be built from.
